# Project records

Records for this project live in this directory.

TDD: strict for parser changes

The work queue is `work.md`.

docs/lusona/work.md.text:
# Work queue

States: Ideas → Ready → Doing → Review → Done. Finish active work before
starting another item, unless the user authorized independent work. Blockers or pending acceptance do not prevent independent authorized
work when writers and unfinished changes stay separated.
Order rows by priority within each state.
Blocked is a flag with a reason and next action, not a separate state.
Explicit batch authorization may override scheduling defaults: deferred items release
execution capacity while retaining their actual state and blocker. Completion requirements still apply.

## Active queue

| Item / change | State | Completion condition | Current blocker or next action |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

No active work selected.

## Icebox

Parked outcomes are excluded from active planning and default batch selection. Move them
back to Active queue only on explicit reactivation; retain their queue state and links.

| Item / change | State when parked | Completion condition | Parking reason / revisit condition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

No parked work.

## Record keeping

Every new spec requires a row; reconcile updates with the same item, preserving existing state,
Icebox, and archived history. New drafts start Ideas; Ready requires accepted scope and criteria,
explicit TDD, and no blocking definition questions. Planning alone never enters Doing.
Direct work without a spec may remain untracked in notes; a follow-up it finds takes an Ideas row
linking those notes. Explicit no-save/read-only restrictions
and coordinator-only shared writes prevail.

Keep one row per open outcome across both sections. Agreement, optional execution steps, evidence,
and one current handoff belong in the linked change record; preserve existing execution records.
Optional `notes/<change-slug>.md` holds durable findings without another owner; do not add
activity logs or evidence paragraphs here. Before removing a completed row, preserve its
completion condition and unique facts, write an entry in `history/YYYY-MM-week-NN.md`,
and verify its evidence links. History owns archived state; reopened work returns here with
a backlink to its historical completion entry.

AGENTS.md.text:
## Lusona skills

This project uses Lusona skills for product and engineering work.

- Invoke the Lusona skill that matches the task: `/lusona:<skill>` in Claude Code, `$lusona:<skill>` in Codex CLI, either form in the Codex desktop app, and the host's skill interface elsewhere. Use `status` when it is unclear which skill applies.
- Project records are under `docs/lusona/`. The work queue is `docs/lusona/work.md`.
